Aabenraa is a Danish municipality whose healthcare data is tracked in the national clinical quality reporting for atrial fibrillation treatment. It is featured in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database, published by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) [^src1]. The report benchmarks clinical quality across all 98 Danish municipalities using data from the National Patient Registry (LPR) and the Danish Stroke Registry (DanStroke) [^src1]. 

Specifically, Aabenraa is evaluated under Indicator 5, which measures the prevention of ischemic stroke via anticoagulation therapy [^src1]. The municipality's data regarding stroke events among atrial fibrillation patients is detailed on page 94 of the report, providing specific metrics to facilitate local quality development and benchmarking within the Danish healthcare system [^src1].
